card.title: Emotional Interest
card.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. Sunday, you owe me an equally embarrassing admission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Now tell her over lunch. Mine had an audience; yours needs one too.

mechanism: A treats a public vulnerable admission as a debt requiring B to take equally public emotional risk.
confusable: Unlike simply asking for honesty, A must compare the scale and audience of the two admissions.
comparison: This eligible alternative uses family lunch and matched exposure; protected D118-b remains context only.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
